$comment: Project ecosystem data model — the single source of truth for descriptive project
facts and GitHub coordinates. Hand-authored; every claim here is traceable to the
repository (README.md, docs/, component manifests) or to the GitHub API.
It deliberately contains NO version numbers and NO release dates. Those come from:
Never hardcode a version, a date, an asset URL, a size or release notes in this file
The project name is spelled PwEevee — capital P, capital E, capital E. Lowercase
'pweevee' appears only in slugs, routes, asset filenames and the canonical hostname.

site.name: PwEevee
site.description: PwEevee is an independent integration and distribution project. It builds, validates and packages a single Spotify IPA that carries the spoti.pw and EeveeSpotify components, publishes it through GitHub releases, and credits the upstream authors who created them.
site.download_policy: Every download on this site resolves to a published GitHub release asset, or to the download URL named by the upstream source that publishes it. Nothing is served from a hand-maintained local file list.
site.attribution: PwEevee integrates components and work from the spoti.pw and EeveeSpotify projects. It did not create them, does not own them, and is not affiliated with them. Please visit their official repositories for upstream information and attribution.
site.disclaimer: Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Spotify AB, Apple Inc., spoti.pw, EeveeSpotify or SideloadLabs. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

projects.name: PwEevee
projects.relationship: This project. The unified build system, validation suite, release infrastructure and this website.
projects.tagline: One tested Spotify IPA carrying two upstream tweaks.
projects.description: PwEevee is the integration layer: it obtains and prepares compatible upstream components, resolves their dependencies (duplicates fail the build), injects the tweaks into a decrypted Spotify binary, validates Mach-O load commands and filesystem structure, packages a reproducible IPA with a full build manifest, and publishes the result through GitHub releases with its exact SHA-256.
projects.contribution: Integration engineering, packaging, validation, publishing and documentation.

authors.name: Maintained by one developer
authors.note: No guaranteed release schedule. See the Development page.

projects.license: The build scripts, website and documentation are this project's own integration glue. They do not and cannot re-license upstream software.
highlights: One authoritative build command — merge, resolve, inject, validate, package, manifest, test
Mach-O load-command injection audited byte-for-byte against a proven reference build
Every published build ships its SHA-256 and a full component manifest
Unsigned output — you sign it with your own certificate

projects.name: spoti.pw
projects.relationship: An independent upstream project, created and maintained by its own author. PwEevee integrates a compatible build of it and claims no ownership.
projects.description: A no-jailbreak Theos tweak that rebuilds Spotify for iOS around a Liquid Glass design: glass tab bar, player and lyrics, Mod Settings, Live Activity, accent colours, gestures, blocked artists, and speed & pitch controls.
projects.contribution: Ships in PwEevee builds as Frameworks/spotifyglass.dylib.
projects.license: PolyForm Strict 1.0.0 for v0.22.0; releases up to v0.21.1 were published under GPL-3.0 and remain under it. Vendored third-party code keeps its own licenses — libbs2b (MIT), WDL/EEL2 (zlib).

support.label: Ko-fi
support.note: Official link, taken from the project's own repository.

highlights: Liquid Glass redesign of the Spotify iOS interface
Mod Settings panel and Live Activity support
Accent colours, gestures, blocked artists, speed & pitch
Builds from source with Theos exactly as upstream documents

projects.name: EeveeSpotify
projects.relationship: An independent upstream project with its own maintainers. PwEevee integrates the upstream package it distributes and claims no ownership of the upstream project. The integration and the unified PwEevee package built around it are PwEevee's own work.
projects.tagline: Premium UI unlock, icons and integration fixes.
projects.description: An upstream Spotify iOS tweak providing premium UI unlock, custom app icons, Siri and media-integration fixes, an offline helper, and theme and localization resources. It is continued as EeveeSpotifyReincarnated by SideloadLabs.
projects.contribution: Ships in PwEevee builds as Frameworks/EeveeSpotify.dylib with the Orion and EeveeSwiftProtobuf frameworks, EeveeSpotify.bundle and 142 custom icons.

github.note: SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated is the canonical repository for this project and the one this site reads. The original author's repository is no longer reachable on GitHub — the API returns HTTP 451, unavailable for legal reasons — and the earlier continuation repository is no longer used here as the upstream reference.
$former_repos: Provenance only, never rendered: the repositories this project previously
tracked, kept so the change is auditable rather than silent.

altsource.name: SideloadLabs Repo
altsource.note: An AltStore-format source published by SideloadLabs. It lists the installable IPA variants and their download URLs. It is NOT a GitHub release; the two are shown separately and labelled. The repository path is spelled SideloasLabs-AltSource upstream and is used exactly as published.

families.label: ESR Liquid Glass
families.note: The Liquid Glass interface variant of the same tweak.

authors.name: SideloadLabs
authors.note: Maintains EeveeSpotifyReincarnated and publishes the AltSource IPA variants.

authors.name: jaydenjcpy
authors.note: Named as Maintainer in the control file of the upstream EeveeSpotify deb that PwEevee obtained and integrates. This credit is for that upstream package, not for PwEevee's integration.

projects.package: com.eevee.spotify.selfcontained — the upstream deb PwEevee obtained and integrates, unmodified. Its own control file names Eevee as Author and jaydenjcpy as Maintainer. The integrated version is recorded per build in the build manifest, not written down here.
projects.license: Distributed upstream as a binary package; its terms travel with it. PwEevee found no separate license file inside the upstream deb it integrates. If the upstream maintainers publish license or source information, it will be reflected here.

support.note: No official donation link was found for EeveeSpotify or EeveeSpotifyReincarnated. None is invented here; if the upstream maintainers publish one it will be added with attribution. This concerns the upstream project only.

pweevee_work.summary: The tweak itself is upstream's work and is credited to its own authors. The four items here are PwEevee's own and are not attributable to Eevee, SideloadLabs or jaydenjcpy.
items: Integration — resolving this component against spoti.pw, injecting the Mach-O load commands, and installing its frameworks, resource bundle and icons into your own Spotify binary.
Unified packaging — the single PwEevee package that carries both components, with its build manifest and SHA-256.
Build and validation — the pipeline that checks the Mach-O binary, every declared dependency, the filesystem layout and the package format before anything is published.
Website presentation and distribution — this site, the generated release data, and the GitHub release the PwEevee download comes from.

highlights: Premium UI unlock and custom app icons
Integrated from the upstream deb, unmodified
notes: PwEevee builds integrate the upstream EeveeSpotify deb recorded in the build manifest. That package version is independent of the latest release published in the upstream repository and of the variants listed in the SideloadLabs AltSource.

dependencies.name: Orion
dependencies.note: Tweak injection runtime by theos, as shipped inside the upstream EeveeSpotify deb.

dependencies.name: EeveeSwiftProtobuf
dependencies.note: Swift protobuf library as shipped in that package.

dependencies.name: CydiaSubstrate
dependencies.note: Saurik's Substrate framework — binary and Info.plist as shipped in the proven spoti.pw build.

dependencies.name: Spotify
dependencies.note: Spotify AB's own software, neither created nor owned by this project. PwEevee's own work is the integration and build workflow around it.
